basic_details.job_title: AMU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Assistant Professor, Senior Resident Posts
basic_details.application_mode: Online application and hard copy by post

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 16 October 2026 (Online up to 11:59 P.M.; Hard copy up to 04:00 P.M.)

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: As per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU

qualification.details: Assistant Professor & Senior Resident: As per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU

how_to_apply: Fill out the Application Form online at the Careers Portal of the University at careers.amuonline.ac.in.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- online (PwD candidates are exempt from fee upon uploading an authentic Disability Certificate).
Take a printout of the PDF file of the Application Form on A-4 size paper, append your signature, and paste a recent photograph at the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents.

Submit the application form by post, complete in all respect, super-scribing on the top-left side of the cover the post applied for, advertisement number, and date, to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002 on or before 24.10.2026. (Note: Last date for receipt of hard copies is 24.10.2026, while the online application deadline is 16.10.2026).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay level for Assistant Professor is AL-10 and for Senior Resident is AL-11. Appointments are made on a purely temporary basis subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason. Candidates applying for Assistant Professor must bring 01 presentation on the topic of their area of interest on their concerned subject in soft copy (pen drive) for presentation at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Mark sheet, certificate, and degree from class Xth to postgraduation Internship completion certificate Valid registration of graduation Post graduation from NMC Other testimonial(s) Experience certificate No Objection Certificate (if employed from the present employer/relieving orders of all previous employers) Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I) for PwD candidates, where applicable

rows.details: Application Form and User Manual Portal

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: Appointments are made on a purely temporary basis subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for an application fee exemption?
faq.answer: PwD candidates are exempted from payment of the prescribed processing fee, provided they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring originals of all required documents for verification at the time of interview, including mark sheets, degrees from class X to postgraduation, internship completion certificate, valid registration, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q4. Can I submit the hard copy of the application after the online deadline?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online application forms is 16.10.2026, and the hard copies will not be received after 24.10.2026 (up to 04:00 p.m.).

faq.question: Q5. Will a separate interview letter be issued?
faq.answer: No separate notice or interview letter will be issued to the candidates in this regard.
